dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: Me? Contarini Tiepolo, of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: I'm on leave at the moment, but if you encounter any violations of the law, please come straight to me anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Contarini
dialogues.text: *sigh* Well, I say that, but it's not often that I come out on vacation, and yet I haven't had enough rest at all... *yawn*
